confluence.note: CONFLUENCE COUNT = integer count of independent pillars that fire, NOT a probability (analyzer refuses a single confidence number). projection.basis: fib targets the analyzer already computes (c_equals_a, c_1.618_a)
projection.zone_confluence_note: no independent VP / liquidity / fib confluence on the zone right now (evidence feeds dark off-hours)
projection.note: PROJECTED, conditional on the count — NOT a prediction. The count can re-label (esp. sub-1h). Invalidation voids it. Price breaking the level is the trigger, not this zone. A ZONE (range), never a point. SHADOW: does not vote, does not change the confirmed count. One wave ahead only.

reliability: low-reliability (sub-1h; re-labels often — structure context, not a signal)
honesty: analyzer.py CANDIDATE read — counts are candidates, NOT predictions. Primary + alternative, each with its invalidation. The count is valid ONLY while its invalidation holds. Levels are the backbone; price breaking a level is the trigger, not the wave label.
subwave_note: Subwaves = ONE finer-degree ZigZag pass (lower-degree, lower-reliability — esp. sub-1h). Cap 2 degrees. A leg with no clean subdivision shows none (not invented).

recommendation.note: SHADOW / informational synthesis of the whole chart — NOT a validated signal, does not vote. The TRIGGER is price breaking the level, not this card. Stop = the count's invalidation; target = the projected zone edge; conviction factors R:R; R:R<1 is not actionable. Counts re-label (esp. sub-1h).

trendlines.basis: objective: lines anchored to analyzer ZigZag pivots, ATR-tolerance touch-counted, angle-filtered.
trendlines.honesty: COINCIDENT structure, not prediction. <3 touches = provisional (not validated). No channel without a real opposite-rail parallel. The CLOSE-break is the trigger, not the line. SHADOW — does not vote. Validated != proven-edge until forward-scored n>=30.
